turns.text: Good afternoon. This is Meera, a consultant with Divyaashree Developers. I'm calling about Whispers of the Wind, near Nundhee Hills. Do you have a couple of minutes to speak?
How did you get this number? I am in a meeting. You people keep calling.
I'm sorry to have caught you at a bad time. I'll let you go.
Don't just let me go. Take me off your list. I do not want another real-estate call.
Understood. I will note that you do not wish to be contacted again. I am sorry for the interruption. Goodbye.
